description: This file defines interfaces related to stream queue load balancing within the Orleans framework. It includes the IStreamQueueBalancer interface for managing queue distribution and notifications, and the IStreamQueueBalanceListener interface for receiving updates on changes in queue load balancing.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalancer
classes.description: Interface responsible for load balancing stream queues and managing queue distribution notifications.

classes.name: IStreamQueueBalanceListener
classes.description: Interface for components that receive notifications about changes in stream queue distribution.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Retrieves the list of queues assigned to this balancer.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from queue distribution change notifications.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Notification method called when the queue distribution has changed.
